patch_description: Introduce trainable feature-scale factors per upload to allow the circuit to adapt its fixed data embedding strength. This adds only 3 extra weights (one per upload) to probe whether flexible encoding enhances expressivity. The feature_map function is modified to multiply FEATURE_SCALE by a trainable factor before each upload.
